title: IVG Smart Max Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Fizzy Cherry blends a deep Cherry flavour with a light sparkling sensation to create a sweet vape with a subtle lift. The fruit note is rich and juicy, while the fizzy backdrop adds brightness, making this a popular choice for fans of sweet-shop-inspired flavours. Each pack includes a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a separate 10ml refill reservoir that clicks into place. Once connected, the reservoir feeds the pod automatically as you vape, potentially supporting up to 10,000 puffs depending on your usage. There’s no need for messy refills or coil swaps. With mesh coil technology for smooth vapour and reliable flavour delivery, this pod is designed for use with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
